comments.text: Pilobol.us is on the standard Papyrus front end and live. Papyrus #415 (written-out dates, released in 5.1.0); Pilobol.us #108 merged (5758ac8): projector, legacy builder, feed generator and reader build removed (~3,470 lines), web/projection.json + theme + hooks.py (290 lines) added. Parity vs old projector, same published data (18 items, Markus 0.7.0): 98 URLs, 0 blocking differences, 21/21 HTML pages DOM-identical after allow-listed items; sitemap URL set, redirects, robots, search data equal; RSS and Atom valid; incremental equals full after 12 random edits. Deployed: Amplify job 48 (backend) then content-actions deploy-render (87 pages written, no drift), one /* invalidation. Live: all 20 old sitemap URLs same status, /feed.xml and /atom.xml valid. Finding: reprojectOnDeploy is not set for this site, so deploy-render is a manual step after a web/ change. Section note: URLs need articles and effects declared as sections; Papyrus 5.1.0 treats effects/index as that section's introduction (listEmpty + page_body hook).
